title: Decode: MegaMoE NVFP4 EP32 + shared-expert overlap
shape: D3-32 r24: 96 requests / DP rank (384 verify rows), SP shard = 96 MoE tokens per GPU, 28 local experts, top-16, L~135K, k=3
basis: current: PROJECTED from the 1-node D3-32 slice (INFRA step_d, L24, EP4 with 28 experts/GPU emulation, mxfp4 ckpt, r24): MegaMoE family exposed 1564 us / 23 layers = 68 us/layer x 92 = 6.3 ms (was 3422 us = 149 us/layer on deep_gemm fp8_fp4). achievable: model rows at EP32 T=96 tokens/GPU: MegaMoE 37.0 us/layer x 92 = 3.40 ms + shared MXFP8 0.95 ms = 4.35 ms; slice model ach for the MegaMoE family at r24 = 1339 us/23 layers. baseline: coordinator seed.
gap_analysis: Step A/B on the 1-node D3-32 slice (L24, u132k, profiled; A = INFRA base deep_gemm fp8_fp4 MegaMoE, B = kimi_k3_mega_moe on the re-vendored FI a368c5f66 kernel, die-local weights, shared expert on the SP side stream): step r8/r16/r24 = 7058/10204/13004 -> 6548/8919/10943 us (-7.2/-12.6/-15.8%). MegaMoE family exposed r24 3422 -> 1564 us (1.17x the slice model achievable 1339 on exposed time; busy 2225 = 1.66x, the shared expert now overlaps it). Remaining kernel gap, MEASURED with globaltimer stamps at the EP32 per-GPU shape on 1 GPU (T96, 48 us/layer vs ~37 model): ~5.5 us before the weight stream starts (router + scheduler publish), weight stream ~34 us at ~85-90% of die-local HBM, ~8.6 us CTA finish imbalance, ~3 us tail barrier/exit, separate top-k reduce ~2.7 us. At EP32 (Hecate, same kernel) dispatch/combine adds ~17 us/layer that is not hidden behind the stream: the 8-node run is needed to split it.
inefficiencies: FIXED on the branch: D3-32 decode used DeepGEMM fp8_fp4 MegaMoE (149 us/layer exposed at r24 in the slice); kimi_k3_mega_moe on the re-vendored kernel: 68 us/layer exposed

MEASURED: CTA finish imbalance ~4 us at the end of the stream (median vs max last-MMA end), then a ~1.2 us tail barrier
MEASURED: separate BF16 top-k reduce kernel ~2.7 us and NVFP4 quant/stage kernel ~1.9 us per call around the persistent kernel
MEASURED (Hecate EP32 vs 1 GPU): ~17 us/call of dispatch/combine latency not hidden behind the weight stream at EP32
MEASURED: stream phase itself ~85-90% of the die-local HBM rate (weights die-localized + die_split active)
